dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A child, out here on their own...

dialogues.speaker: Moce
dialogues.text: Hmm? A child? Where from? Did some new legionnaire disobey orders and bring their family into the camp again...?

dialogues.speaker: Moce
dialogues.text: *sigh* Dominus Cassiodor is far too gentle with these greenhorns. If this were to have happened three decades prior, a Tribunus would've had a whip out by now...
